people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”
translations.bsb: “Receive your sight!” Jesus replied. “Your faith has healed you.”
translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
translations.asv: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight; thy faith hath made thee whole.
